notes:
• Paris: the workspace follows the current macOS design — ribbon tabs, quota chip and search now sit in a real window toolbar next to the traffic lights (Liquid Glass on macOS 26, the native unified toolbar on 14/15); the empty title-bar row is gone.
• Toolbar and ribbon are one surface without a separator; the page-tools bar over the PDF preview is Liquid Glass on macOS 26; the detail pane is a native inspector.
• Ribbon titles, button tints and the quota chip re-resolve their colours on every light/dark switch (no more washed-out labels after an automatic switch).
